svg.title: RiboSurfBind: shared initial-state contribution and equivalent GCNII update
svg.desc: B区域采用与现有公式等价的分解画法。令 Tℓ = θℓWℓ + (1−θℓ)I，层框表示 (1−α)M⁽ℓ⁾Tℓ + D⁽ℓ−1⁾，上方共享H⁽⁰⁾通路向第ℓ层加号输入 αH⁽⁰⁾Tℓ；两项相加后经ReLU得到H⁽ℓ⁾。两个通路中的Tℓ使用同一组参数，不引入新模块或参数。公式、实现和模型权重均不改变。

g.aria-label: Schematic dense ERNIE-RNA attention map before semantic top-k selection
Illustrative spatial residue graph. Node colors are decorative; edges do not enumerate the full kNN adjacency.
64D surface point features belonging to residue i undergo max and attention pooling; the two 64D outputs concatenate into one 128D residue feature.

svg.text: M: surface points; N: residues. Graphs and feature colors are schematic.
svg.desc: Panel E depicts one layer: the gate uses separately normalized current state, semantic and spatial messages, and their absolute normalized difference. MLP and a two-relation softmax produce two scalar weights per residue. These weights multiply the original aggregated messages; their sum is passed to GCNII. Gate parameters are shared across residues within a layer and independent across layers. Named input tensors correspond to the same messages illustrated in the two horizontal paths.

g.aria-label: Read right to left: separate LayerNorm, concatenate two 128D branch features, MLP 256 to 128 to 1, sigmoid and binary decision.
